kjv: [how] thou (God) didst afflict the people, and cast them out (KJV 44:2)
mine: You (God) afflicted the peoples, but them (Israel's fathers) You set free
note: watteshallehem "and you sent them out": the pronoun most naturally refers, like "you planted them", to Israel spreading out like a vine (80:11), not to the expelled nations.
tannim are jackals, inhabitants of ruins (cf. Job 30:29), not dragons; the KJV may have read tannin "sea monster".
